item.description:
CoreBlow 2.1.1

Highlights

  • CoreBlow Studio Desktop: Electron + Vite + React desktop companion with CLI session handoff and sandbox protection.
  • Headless & Resumable CLI: coreblow -p headless prompt execution, -c / -r session continuation and interactive picker.
  • SQLite WAL + FTS5: Persistent multi-process session store with fast BM25 full-text indexing and Cory memory knowledge scribe.
  • Sovereign MCP Bridge: 75 native tools, dynamic plugin tool collision namespacing, and notification wire protocol.
  • AST Skill Security Scanner: Static analysis guardrails for community cognitive skills.
  • Per-Channel-Peer DM Isolation: Default cross-channel security boundaries.
